summary: Provides infrastructure components for reading, writing, and configuring CSV data parsing and serialization using Pydantic models.
responsibilities: Define configuration options for CSV parsing, encoding, IO, headers, and columns
Read and parse CSV data into validated Pydantic models or raw string dictionaries
Write and convert Pydantic model records to CSV format and files
relationships: CSV reader uses CSV parsing, encoding, and IO options to read and validate data into Pydantic models
CSV writer uses CSV writing options to serialize Pydantic model records to CSV format
design_decisions: Uses Pydantic models for data validation and representation in CSV operations
